thread:
evan: Heads-up — FinLedger support opened a P0: decrypts failing intermittently after our key rotation on 2025-11-02 in us-east-1. They also report a missing CloudTrail export for ~20m during the rotation window. :rotating_light:
support-bot: Ticket #SUP-15901 created and assigned to eng-security.
julie: Can someone paste the exact error the customer sees and any request ids?
maria: Their mobile client logs show: `Decrypt error: AccessDeniedException: "Unable to decrypt"` and our proxy returned 403 with `proxy_req_id=plx-77f`. They also included `awsRequestId=7a9c` from their SDK.
nashwin: Customer says issue started immediately after the scheduled rotation (2025-11-02T02:05:00Z). Before rotation success rate ~99.9%, after rotation ~12% success for decrypt. CLI calls succeed when they pass encryption-context.
sean: Two parallel tracks: (1) why KMS decrypts are AccessDenied for this tenant after rotation, (2) why CloudTrail export for that time window is missing.
maria: FinLedger provided a minimal repro. AWS CLI decrypt with `--encryption-context Tenant=finledger` succeeds. Their mobile SDK calls fail. They captured a proxy debug line: `warning: missing header x-amz-encryption-context for path /kms/Decrypt; tenant=finledger; proxy=plx-77f`.
nashwin: Suspect the tenant proxy is stripping or truncating the X-Amz-Encryption-Context header under certain chunked transfer encodings introduced by last week's proxy deploy. If the key policy enforces `kms:EncryptionContext:Tenant`, KMS will deny.
julie: Paste the rotated key ARN and policy condition?
sean: Key ARN: `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:210987654321:key/rot-2025-11-02-xyz`. Policy snippet shows: "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"kms:EncryptionContext:Tenant": "finledger"}} — so it's explicitly gating on the context.
maria: That aligns with CLI pass vs SDK fail. CLI injects encryption-context param, SDK likely sends a header that got munged/cased differently or removed.
oncall: I pulled proxy logs for plx-77f around the rotation time: spike of HTTP/1.1 requests with chunked body combos; a post-deploy proxy config enabled `proxy_buffering` which interacts badly with chunked header parsing in our custom header-preserve filter. There are ~3k requests where `x-amz-encryption-context` is absent.
gabe: On the audit side: the CloudTrail retention/export job to our compliance bucket failed during the same window with `AccessDenied: s3:PutObject` for the export role. Investigating why — initial hypothesis: during rotation the export IAM role used a KMS grant that was briefly invalid while key grants were being reissued, so S3 PutObject failed. Ops changed bucket policy as part of the rotation hardening and maybe locked out the export role for a short period.
sean: So two correlated failures: proxy header truncation -> encryption-context stripped -> KMS denies decrypt; and export job failing -> missing CloudTrail files for compliance window. Both triggered during rotation change.
julie: Impact: FinLedger sees intermittent decrypt failures (~88% failing in the affected window) and now has an audit gap ~20m long. P0 for customer SLA and security/compliance.
maria: Immediate mitigations we can do right now?
oncall: Short term: 1) Revert the proxy change that enabled `proxy_buffering` on plx-77f and restart the daemon (targeted rollback to that instance group). 2) Add a temporary header-rewrite rule to force-preserve `x-amz-encryption-context` -> forward to KMS path. 3) Re-run CloudTrail export for 2025-11-02 window once S3 policy/role are validated.
nashwin: I'll cut a hotfix PR (#4687) that adds the header-preserve rule and a unit test for chunked requests. Can we avoid a full fleet restart? Targeted restart for plx-77f group only.
gabe: I'm re-running the export now after adjusting the bucket policy to explicitly allow the export role. If it fails again, I'll escalate to infra and open an S3 outage. I'll also pull CloudTrail event history for KMS Decrypt calls to show sequence numbers and missing event ranges for the customer's key ARN.
maria: Forensics: can oncall upload anonymized proxy request traces and the decrypted/non-decrypted request ids for the customer? We need evidence for compliance and to share with FinLedger.
oncall: Uploaded sanitized logs to the secure case store: s3://redwood-secure-cases/SUP-15901/proxy-plx-77f-2025-11-02.log (access limited). Also attached CloudTrail re-run artifacts once complete.
julie: Customer communication: I'll tell FinLedger we've identified a proxy header-handling regression introduced in the rotation cutover, a hotfix and targeted rollback are in flight, and we're re-running audit exports to restore compliance logs. Offer them a temporary client-side mitigation: ensure the SDK explicitly sets encryption-context as a parameter (not only a header) or route critical decrypts via a bypass path (requires ops approval).
sean: Longer-term action items for post-mortem: a) remove sole reliance on encryption-context in key policy (add a service principal fallback or a grant that survives rotations), b) add automated e2e tests that simulate chunked HTTP headers through our proxy filter, c) include audit-export preflight checks in rotation runbooks, d) add a post-rotation verification that CloudTrail files for key-related events were successfully pushed to retention.
maria: We'll compile this into SUP-15901 RCA checklist and include timelines, logs, and PR references.
julie: I'll prepare the customer update draft and send after rollback + export re-run succeed. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: SUP-15901 updated: status=in_progress; hotfix PR=#4687; targeted rollback scheduled 2025-11-02T03:20:00Z; audit re-export queued.
